en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a garden walkway lined with large statues of robed apostles set on a high terrace wall beside a historic building. Several people, likely seminarians, sit and stand along the shaded path below the statues. Handwritten Hungarian caption appears at the bottom of the image. The reverse side has a Hungarian postage stamp, postmark, printed Hungarian text, and a handwritten message and address.
